notes: Single DUT and single complementary EPC2361, not a parallel-bank/module transient model.
All parasitics, driver resistance/edge speed, and pulse timings are assumptions to sweep or replace with extracted/measured values.
Common-source inductance is additional to the swept bus-side loop inductance.
The complementary gate stays off, so freewheel conduction is third-quadrant channel conduction.
First pulse duration approximately L*I/V establishes current. Actual edge currents are reported.
Temperature is fixed; this is not an electrothermal simulation. The vendor model has no modeled breakdown/destruction limit.
